caption: The drawing is a monochrome, line-art illustration containing multiple clothing pattern pieces arranged within a single rectangular frame on a lightly yellowed background. The objects include various geometric shapes representing cut-out garment components, each labeled with letters and numbers such as "A-1", "A-2", "B-1", "C," and "D-2", along with corresponding notations in parentheses and occasionally additional marks or arrows. The largest pieces, placed toward the top left, are elongated curved rectangles labeled "CENTER FRONT" and "CENTER BACK", while smaller rectangular, curved, and irregular-shaped pieces are distributed throughout the composition. Some pieces have dashed lines, cross marks, or small triangles indicating folds, notches, or seam allowances. There is also a vertical, narrow rectangular piece with parallel lines and notations labeled “C.B.” and “C.2.” in the lower left quadrant. All lines and text are uniformly thin and gray, giving a technical, schematic appearance to the illustration.
title: Boy's Suit
